Comment.value: Divine Champion initiation reward (roadmap: divine-champion-quest), given by q_dvc_finish with 1000 XP when the Oath-Light of the West is handed to Halmir. Mirrors the sibling prestige rewards' power tier (three +3-tier properties, no AB/damage -- forge-cap-safe), themed for the shield of others: Heal +3 (skill subtype 4, SKILL_HEAL), Persuade +3 (skill subtype 12, SKILL_PERSUADE), Saving Throw Bonus vs Divine +3 (IP_CONST_SAVEVS_DIVINE = 6, verified in ovr/nwscript.nss; no SAVEVS_EVIL constant exists). Deliberately avoids all sibling reward skills (Discipline/Parry on the WM buckle, Concentration on the AA bracers, etc.). BaseItem 80 (cloak) + ModelPart1 5 copied from the module's existing Archer's Wrap (007).

value.0: A mantle of undyed wool in the grey-white of the Tree in flower, clasped with a plain disc of silver bearing no device -- the Champions say the shield is the device, and it rides the other arm. The chaplains of Minas Tirith lay it on those whose vow was renewed at the Altar of the Istari: sworn before the White Tree, keeping the vigil shield on arm, standing between the faithful and what comes. Halmir the Grey gave it over when the oath-light was laid in his hand -- the token of those the orders call Divine Champions, whose page he keeps near the top of the roll, where the light falls.
